citations.claim: Cart exceeds track limit at first violating step, x=2.4055 > 2.4
One step before violation cart was still inside track and moving outward

explanation: Controller fails to keep cart on track for heavy pole / high gravity with large initial displacement: starting from theta=0.2, omega=0.5 it drifts with sustained positive velocity (~1.0 at step 100, ~1.37 at step 127) under small positive controller force (~1.2N, well below limit), so cart position integrates past 2.4m at step 128 while pole remains upright (theta~0.05). Likely cause is state-feedback gains prioritize pole angle over cart position, with insufficient cart-position correction to arrest drift.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.406 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart drifts steadily to the right toward the end of the track while the pole remains nearly upright. By step 128 the cart reaches and passes the track edge with the pole still balanced on top.
